about: Every visual stage of the battles, oldest first: milestones, review rounds and fixes. scripts/timeline.mjs (track "battles") turns this into timeline.gif. Add a stage with every visual commit; never overwrite a stage's picture. A commit cannot name itself, so the newest stage says "next" until the following commit fills in its hash.

stages.title: B2 · Style frame
stages.note: Google Flow art at full resolution: a sword squad against its red twin on the meadow.

stages.title: B2 r1 · Men and women
stages.note: A woman leader and soldier from Flow: Aria leads, and both squads mix men and women.

stages.title: B2 · Animation test
stages.note: Round 2: Aria's attack from pose images with a code-drawn smear, beside the same attack from a Veo 3.1 clip.

stages.title: B2 r1 · Motion between poses
stages.note: The same poses with breathing, eased lunges, a hit-stop, screen shake and dust; a victory pose.

stages.title: B2 · Bram, the first new leader
stages.note: Standing image from Google Flow, 10 poses from Seedream; a spear thrust with a straight streak.

stages.title: B2 · Edric, the first rider
stages.note: A mounted knight: horse and rider pose together, a four-pose gallop, a lance charge.

stages.title: B2 · Corin, the axe
stages.note: An overhead chop with its own arc; one pose regenerated, sizes matched to the stance.

stages.title: B2 · Dela and Ilse, the ranged heroes
stages.note: An arrow and a magic bolt drawn in code; the six player heroes are done.

stages.title: B2 · The rival army's six leaders
stages.note: Varek, Sabine, Gorran, Petra, Ulric and Morwen: Flow standing images, Seedream poses, their own swings, streaks, arrow and crimson bolt.

stages.title: B2 · The twelve soldiers
stages.note: A man and a woman for each class: Flow standing images, Seedream poses, their own swings, streaks, arrows and pale blue bolts; soldiers stand smaller than leaders.

stages.title: B3 · The squads take the field
stages.note: Any matchup in the battle scene: each side's leader and its soldiers in formation, men and women in turn, the enemy's soldiers recoloured red in the shader; riders in two looser ranks.

stages.title: B3 · The battle plays out
stages.note: The rules decide and the scene plays it: the charge, the counter, the duels, panic and flashes, falls, the winners' cheer and the Morale lost; the HUD follows live and Space skips to the result.

stages.title: B3 r1 · Opposite numbers, and Morale in the ranks
stages.note: Head fights head and soldier fights soldier until one falls, then the free fighters spread over the soldiers left and reach the head last; a wounded unit brings fewer soldiers; the fallen fade back to lie at their own places.

stages.title: B3 · Stance and the skill gauge
stages.note: A, S and D set the player's stance from the next beat; each banner shows its edge; the skill gauge fills as blows land, half again as fast when aggressive and not at all when passive.
